none: PAS LANCUM-980556: Roman coin: Sestertius of Marcus Aurelius
contea di ritrovamento: Cumbria (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ M ANTONINVS AVG [ARM PARTH MAX] ; R/ [TR POT] XXII IMP [IIII COS III] S-C

A worn copper alloy Roman sestertius of Marcus Aurelius (AD 161-180), dating to the period AD 166-168. Reece Period 8. Mint of Rome. Victory advancing left with wreath and palm reverse type, RIC 952. Obverse description: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: M ANTONINVS AVG [ARM PARTH MAX]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [TR POT]…
